mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates on future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when rates exceed 5.0%.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is positive (>= 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals labor market tightness that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5 over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals robust economic expansion that accelerates profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5 and INDPRO > 100 over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS < 690000) signals weakening demand that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 690000 and FEDFUNDS is rising (over the last 3 months) over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 signals strong manufacturing output that accelerates corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100 over the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.4% in the past month signals immediate labor market strength that drives short-term equity buying, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.4 over the next 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400 over the next 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 300), a decline in consumer spending (RSAFS < 690000) signals household demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300 and RSAFS < 690000 over the next 60 days.
